description.value: The Strawberry Hill Branch is a 11,100 sq. ft. single-floor public library operated by Surrey Libraries in the Strawberry Hill neighbourhood of Surrey. Located roughly 400m from the Scottsdale Exchange, it is served by over ten Translink bus routes and offers free parking on site. The branch includes a public art installation of E.D. Blodgett poetry above the service desk, giving it a modest cultural draw alongside its practical amenities.
